name: When is it better to renovate an existing space versus building a new one?

mainEntity.name: When is it better to renovate an existing space versus building a new one?

acceptedAnswer.text: Deciding between renovating an existing commercial space and building new depends on several factors. Renovation can be more cost-effective and faster if the existing structure meets most of your needs and requires only interior modifications. It also often allows for occupancy sooner. Building new offers complete design freedom and modern efficiencies but comes with higher costs, longer timelines, and more extensive permitting. The primary decision factor often lies in the existing building's structural integrity, location advantages, and how well its current layout can be adapted to your business vision compared to the benefits of a ground-up construction.
acceptedAnswer.description: Renovating is often faster and cheaper for suitable existing structures, while building new offers full design freedom at higher cost and time commitment.
